adjudication.rationale: Looking at line 253-254 in the diff, the code changes from `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId` to `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. When `externalCalendarId` is undefined/null (the fallback case), this `.find()` will search for a calendar where `externalId === undefined`, which will likely return undefined. The original code would fall back to the destination calendar's externalId, but the new code will pass undefined to the Google API. This is a logical bug - the fallback condition is broken because you're searching for a match with the very value you're trying to fall back from.
